_description: Metalmeccanica Industria (CNEL C011) level D1, June 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the first month of the tranche of 1 June 2026.
_notes: Minimo D1 1,742.03 from 1 June 2025 (minutes of 12 June 2025) and 1,784.94 from 1 June 2026 (renewal of 22 November 2025, page 2, ratified by the referendum of 18-20 February 2026).
The minutes of 16 June 2026 absorb the IPCA share in the June 2026 tranche: the minimo stays 1,784.94.
Base salary only: the allowances and the gross depend on facts outside the national table.
